paragraphs.text: At MobiProp, your privacy is fundamental to everything we do. This Privacy Policy describes how MobiProp S.A. ("MobiProp," "we," "our," or "us") collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you visit our website, use our mobile application, or engage with our real estate services.

By using our platform, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. We encourage you to read it in full to understand our commitment to protecting your personal information.

This policy applies to all users of MobiProp's digital services, including property buyers, sellers, renters, landlords, and anyone who submits an inquiry through our platform. Last updated: August 24, 2026.
We collect several types of information to provide and improve our services:
Personal Identification Information
When you register an account, submit a property inquiry, or contact our agents, we collect your full name, email address, phone number, and mailing address.
Property & Transaction Data

To facilitate property searches and transactions, we collect information about properties you view, save, or inquire about, including search filters, preferred neighborhoods, budget ranges, and property preferences.
Usage & Device Information

We automatically collect information about how you interact with our platform: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, pages visited, time spent on each page, referral URLs, and clickstream data. This helps us improve our service and detect issues.
Communication Records
Any messages you send through our platform — whether to agents, property owners, or our support team — are stored to maintain a record of your interactions and improve our service quality.
Financial Information

When facilitating transactions, we may collect payment details. All payment processing is handled by PCI-DSS compliant third-party payment processors. We do not store full credit card numbers on our servers.
We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
Service Delivery
To connect you with properties and agents, process inquiries, schedule viewings, and facilitate real estate transactions from search through closing.
Communication
To send you property alerts, respond to inquiries, provide transaction updates, and send service-related notifications. You may opt out of marketing communications at any time.
Platform Improvement
To analyze usage patterns, fix bugs, develop new features, and continuously improve the quality and relevance of our property listings and search tools.
Legal & Compliance
To comply with applicable laws, respond to legal requests, enforce our Terms of Service, and protect the rights and safety of MobiProp, our users, and the public.
Personalization
To tailor property recommendations, search results, and content to your preferences and browsing history on our platform.
We process your data on the legal basis of legitimate interest, contractual necessity, or your explicit consent, depending on the specific processing activity.
MobiProp uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your experience:
Essential Cookies
Required for the platform to function — session management, authentication, and security features. These cannot be disabled.
Analytics Cookies
Help us understand how visitors use our site (via tools like Google Analytics). We use this data in aggregate to improve site performance. You may opt out through your browser settings.
Preference Cookies
Remember your language, currency, search filters, and other settings between visits to make your experience more seamless.
Marketing Cookies
Used to show you relevant property listings and MobiProp advertisements on partner websites. You may opt out through our Cookie Preferences panel or industry opt-out tools.
You can manage your cookie preferences at any time through our Cookie Settings link in the footer. Note that disabling certain cookies may affect platform functionality.
We share your information only in the following circumstances:
With Real Estate Agents & Partners
When you submit a property inquiry or request a viewing, we share your contact information with the relevant licensed agent or property owner to facilitate the connection.
Service Providers

We work with trusted third-party companies who assist us in operating our platform (hosting providers, email services, analytics tools, payment processors). These providers are contractually bound to handle your data securely and use it only for the purposes we specify.
Legal Requirements
We may disclose information when required by law, court order, or governmental authority, or when we believe disclosure is necessary to protect our rights, your safety, or the safety of others.
Business Transfers

In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or part of MobiProp's assets, your information may be transferred to the acquiring entity, subject to the same privacy protections described in this policy.
We do not sell your personal information to third parties for their own marketing purposes.
